Linux Systems Administrator 
 Linux Infrastructure, Kubernetes & Bare-Metal Systems 
 Contract: Fixed-term contract (FTC), 12 months initially
 Location: Remote
 About the role
 We are looking for a hands-on Linux Systems Administrator to support and maintain a large-scale AI/HPC infrastructure environment.
 The role will focus primarily on Linux system administration, supporting bare-metal servers and Kubernetes-based infrastructure. You will be responsible for maintaining system health, troubleshooting infrastructure issues, managing configurations and ensuring the underlying environment remains stable, secure and operational.
 You will work alongside experienced infrastructure and platform engineers, providing day-to-day administration and operational support across Linux servers, physical hardware and containerised environments.
 This is a practical, technically focused role suited to someone with solid Linux administration experience who is comfortable working directly with server infrastructure and has experience supporting Kubernetes environments.
 What you will do 
Administer, maintain and troubleshoot Linux-based server environments.
Support bare-metal infrastructure, including physical servers, hardware components, operating systems and server provisioning.
Install, configure, patch and maintain Linux operating systems.
Monitor system performance, resource utilisation and overall infrastructure health.
Troubleshoot server, operating system, networking, storage and connectivity issues.
Support Kubernetes environments, including cluster nodes, pods, services, deployments and container-related issues.
Investigate and resolve system errors, service failures and performance bottlenecks.
Carry out routine maintenance, system upgrades, patching and configuration changes.
Work with networking and storage technologies, including TCP/IP, DNS, routing, NFS and filesystem management.
Use scripting and automation to improve routine administration and operational processes.
Maintain technical documentation, procedures and operational runbooks.
Work with senior engineers to investigate more complex infrastructure issues and support continuous improvements.
 What you will bring 
Strong hands-on experience in Linux system administration.
Good knowledge of Linux distributions such as Ubuntu, Red Hat, Rocky Linux or CentOS.
Practical experience managing and troubleshooting bare-metal servers and physical infrastructure.
Experience working with Kubernetes, with an understanding of cluster architecture, nodes, pods, services and workloads.
Solid understanding of server hardware, CPU, memory, storage and system performance.
Good knowledge of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, routing and connectivity troubleshooting.
Experience with storage technologies, filesystems and permissions.
A structured approach to troubleshooting, problem-solving and incident resolution.
Comfortable working in a production environment where system reliability and operational discipline are important.
 Nice to have 
Experience supporting GPU-based infrastructure or AI/HPC environments.
